_note: Thresholds for this recipe. Run with b-qa-gate: check.py --kind reel --spec acceptance.json --input FILE --out SCORECARD. Mechanical kinds are measured by the block; kind perceptual becomes a LOOK row the bot answers with --finalize. A check kind the block does not know is a FAIL. A brand may tighten these checks, never weaken them.

checks._note: The mechanical reel floor owned by b-qa-gate: video stream, audio, 1080x1920, frame rate, length, loudness and the frame-0 cover rule, one row each. It is not an aggregate of the looks or of this recipe's own guards (frame_qa.py); those run separately.
Cover rule: frame 0 is a bright frame OR a dark card with a bright headline; a flat dark/black frame fails.

checks.desc: (a) No overlapping or jumbled text — one beat's text visible at a time, beats are strictly sequential.
(b) Graphics beats show a brand motion graphic (not a photo or blank rectangle); b-roll beats show real footage scaled-to-cover with no black bars.
(c) Text is legible at mobile size — 60px+ headlines, AA contrast, no tiny or illegible copy.

(d) Brand colors are correct per the brand's palette — not defaulted to white-on-black or any non-brand palette. If a brand font named in the brief was not installed and the generic family was used, say so in the note; that is not a failure by itself.
(e) No □ tofu boxes anywhere — all icons are inline SVG or CSS, zero unicode glyphs that the headless renderer cannot resolve.

(f) Every graphics beat made by card_fill.py (every type except hook and typing) has a ghost glyph that is a thematic number or single letter (beat index, listicle total, or deliberate initial), never a placeholder word like 'CTA', 'TITLE', or 'HEADER'. The hook and typing cards have no ghost glyph by design and are not judged here. If the reel has no card_fill beat, answer yes and say so in the note.

(g) A FOREGROUND HERO is present and dominant on every card_fill beat and every typing beat (the chat card is its hero): bright headline plus an animated diagram, chart, checklist or card, not a ghost-glyph-only frame. A hook card is judged by its big title lines (it has no hero by design). If the reel has only hook cards, answer yes and say so in the note.
(h) Brand outro appears at approximately the final 3% of the reel (brand name + CTA, not a content beat).
(i) Cover freeze at t≈0 shows the money-shot — not a black frame or hook-animation blank.

checks._note: One loudness target for reels: -14 LUFS integrated on the delivered file.

checks.desc: Cards and captions use Latin script with phonetic transliteration, preserving the original meaning.
Every b-roll window shows the exact staged clip/window planned by the bot; all-graphics orders have no b-roll windows.
